name: check_trades
description: Before placing an order, state which of the owner's own Allocait rules the proposed change would put outside range or leave further outside. Send only the trades; the bot's own code adds the prices. A result inside every range does not say a change is advisable. Allocait cannot approve, stop or place an order.

symbol.description: A ticker, or a pair written BASE/USD.

shares.description: Units; fractions allowed. Send this or notional.

asset_class.description: Needed only for a symbol not held yet, e.g. Equities or Crypto.
